ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a signal flow graph from left to right, where input u enters the left summing node, and then passes through n cascaded integration elements s^{-1}. Along the horizontal chain, the state labels visible in the figure are arranged in reverse order from left to right as x_n, x_{n-1}, …, x_3, x_2, x_1, and the rightmost side is the output y. The left summing node has feedback branches returning from each state, with gains labeled in sequence as -a_1, -a_2, …, -a_n; above there are also feedforward branches to the output end, including the direct channel b_0, and the branches b_1, b_2, …, b_n from each state to the output. Reasoning: Take the conventional state vector x=[x_1,x_2,...,x_n]^T. Due to the relation of the cascaded integrator chain, there are dot{x}_1=x_2, dot{x}_2=x_3, …, dot{x}_{n-1}=x_n. The left summing node, as the input of the derivative of the last state, receives u and the feedback -a_1 x_n, -a_2 x_{n-1}, …, -a_n x_1, therefore dot{x}_n=-a_n x_1-a_{n-1}x_2-...-a_1x_n+u. The output end is composed of state branches and the direct branch, therefore y=b_n x_1+b_{n-1}x_2+...+b_1x_n+b_0u.

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: identify the cascade of n integrators and assign the state vector in the conventional order [x_1, x_2, ..., x_n]^T, noting that the visible chain labels appear reversed along the drawing from x_n toward x_1. From the integrator chain write the shift equations dot{x}_1=x_2, dot{x}_2=x_3, ..., dot{x}_{n-1}=x_n. Then read the left summing node: it receives u and feedback inputs -a_1x_n, -a_2x_{n-1}, ..., -a_nx_1, so dot{x}_n=-a_nx_1-a_{n-1}x_2-...-a_1x_n+u. Convert these scalar equations into xdot=Ax+Bu with A having ones on the superdiagonal and last row [-a_n, -a_{n-1}, ..., -a_1], B=[0,0,...,1]^T. Finally read the output arcs b_n through b_1 from states x_1 through x_n plus the direct path b_0u, giving y=[b_n, b_{n-1}, ..., b_1]x+b_0u.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个从左到右的信号流图，输入 u 进入左侧求和节点，随后经过 n 个串联的积分环节 s^{-1}。沿水平链路可见状态标号在图中从左到右呈 x_n, x_{n-1}, …, x_3, x_2, x_1 的反向排列，最右侧为输出 y。左侧求和节点有从各状态返回的反馈支路，增益依次标为 -a_1, -a_2, …, -a_n；上方还有到输出端的前向支路，包含直接通道 b_0，以及从各状态到输出的 b_1, b_2, …, b_n 支路。推理：按常规状态向量取 x=[x_1,x_2,...,x_n]^T。由于串联积分链的关系，有 dot{x}_1=x_2, dot{x}_2=x_3, …, dot{x}_{n-1}=x_n。左侧求和节点作为最后一个状态导数的输入，接收 u 以及反馈 -a_1 x_n, -a_2 x_{n-1}, …, -a_n x_1，因此 dot{x}_n=-a_n x_1-a_{n-1}x_2-...-a_1x_n+u。输出端由状态支路和直接支路组成，因此 y=b_n x_1+b_{n-1}x_2+...+b_1x_n+b_0u。
